statements.name: Agent100.ThirdGate.numeric_six_boundary
statements.signature_source:
theorem numeric_six_boundary (n : Nat) (d : Nat → Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hc : Canonical n d (2 * r + 7))
    (hq : ∀ i, i < 2 * r + 7 →
      columnSum d (2 * r + 7) i = DoubleGate.initial r i) :
    ∃ e, Canonical (orbit n 6) e (2 * r + 8) ∧
      columnSum e (2 * r + 8) 0 = 15 ∧
      (∀ i, i < 2 * r + 8 →
        columnSum e (2 * r + 8) i = (wholeOrbit r 6).2 i)

statements.name: Agent100.ThirdGate.numeric_third_overlap_fails

theorem numeric_third_overlap_fails (n : Nat) (d : Nat → Nat) (r : Nat)
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hc : Canonical n d (2 * r + 7))
    (hq : ∀ i, i < 2 * r + 7 →
      columnSum d (2 * r + 7) i = DoubleGate.initial r i) :
    ∃ e, Canonical (orbit n 6) e (2 * r + 8) ∧
      ¬ ∀ i, i < 2 * r + 8 →
        columnSum e (2 * r + 8) i =
          DelayedOverlapGate.shiftOne
            (finiteWord (componentOrbit r 6).1 (componentOrbit r 6).2) i

      (∃ e, Canonical (orbit n 6) e (2 * r + 8) ∧
        columnSum e (2 * r + 8) 0 = 15)
